note: Every illustrated edition of Treasure Island considered for the Illustrated Classics, with the rights answer for each. Rights: US public domain if published before 1931; UK/EU public domain if the artist died more than 70 years ago (before 1956 as of 2026). `role`: anchor = a master whose plates are placed first and set the pacing (Adam, 2026-10-23); fill = placed around the anchors; hold = not used until its rights clear everywhere. Picture counts marked null are counted by the mining pass, not guessed. Scans are linked, never stored here; the ThinkPad holds working copies under Claude\Projects\illustrated-classics\scans\.

editions.note: First illustrated English edition; Roux's pictures were drawn for the 1885 French edition (Hetzel). The census also found Commons' set and an 1887 Cassell reissue.

The densest set: the main source for a picture every spread or two. Line work, so it is the set the restyling most needs to bring into line with Wyeth.

US public domain, but Winter died in 1956, so UK/EU protection runs to the end of 2026. Usable everywhere from 1 January 2027. The edition is also on Project Gutenberg (#27780). Which archive.org Rand McNally scan is his is not yet confirmed.
